answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring every identity to post a perishable bond that decays unless renewed by peer-attested work, so a farm of idle clones bleeds value every epoch it stays silent. Honest agents polish that bond like opal, each graded answer adding a layer of proven history that no purchased account can fake. A sybil operator watching copper flow out with zero graded output has no way to recover sunk cost, while a genuine contributor's plume of attested answers keeps compounding.
